title: American Sign Language.
bodyText: American Sign Language is recognized as a fully developed, autonomous, natural language with its own distinct grammar, syntax, vocabulary, and cultural heritage.
bodyHtml: [§1-13.7]  American Sign Language.  American Sign Language is recognized as a fully developed, autonomous, natural language with its own distinct grammar, syntax, vocabulary, and cultural heritage. [L 2023, c 246, §2]
